What it solves: - "[2026-08-29] specifier, on minting: the expeditor is NOT at fault for
  failing to un-park. `expedite_lib.bb` parks to hold/ deliberately and
  `parked-report` explicitly declines to promote back, citing Article 3.1.
  Both are correct in isolation. The defect is that nobody owns the

Approval context: One thing needs sign-off: the call site. The recommendation is `promote_and_route_next.sh`, the same site BL-1228 was ruled onto, so both pool audits run at the one moment the coordinator is already touching the backlog. That is cheap and adds no daemon, but it means a divergence that appears while…
